G0901.strongs: profound (as going down), literally or figuratively
senses: deep; [[r:JHN.4.11|Jhn 4:11]]; metaphorically, ὄρθρου βαθέως (see supr.), early dawn, [[r:LUK.24.1|Luk 24:1]]; ὕπνος, [[r:ACT.20.9|Act 20:9]]; τὰ β. τοῦ Σατανᾶ, [[r:REV.2.24|Rev 2:24.]]† (AS)

G0902.root: a diminutive of a derivative probably of the base of [[w:G0939]]
G0902.strongs: a palm twig (as going out far)
senses: (also βὰϊον, another form of βὰϊς, from the Egyptian), (frequently in Egyptian π., see MM, Exp., x) a palm-branch: [[r:JHN.12.13|Jhn 12:13]] (DB, i, 314).† (AS)

G0903.forms: Βαλαάμ, ὁ, indecl. (Heb. בִּלְעָם), as in LXX (FlJ has ὁ βάλαμος)
G0903.strongs: Balaam, a Mesopotamian (symbolic of a false teacher)

G0906.strongs: to throw (in various applications, more or less violent or intense)
G0906.kjv: arise, cast (out), X dung, lay, lie, pour, put (up), send, strike, throw (down), thrust
senses: prop., of a weapon or missile; then generally, of things and persons, lit. and metaphorically, to throw, cast, put, place: with accusative, before εἰς, [[r:MAT.4.18|Mat 4:18]], and frequently ἐπί, [[r:MAT.10.34|Mat 10:34]]; κάτω, [[r:MAT.4.6|Mat 4:6]]; ἔξω, [[r:MAT.5.13|Mat 5:13]]; ἀπό, [[r:MAT.5.29|Mat 5:29]]; ἐκ, [[r:MRK.12.44|Mrk 12:44]]; δρέπανον, [[r:REV.14.19|Rev 14:19]]; μάχαιραν, [[r:MAT.10.34|Mat 10:34]]; κλῆρον, [[r:MAT.27.35|Mat 27:35]]; of fluids, to pour: [[r:MAT.9.17|Mat 9:17]], [[r:JHN.13.5|Jhn 13:5]]; pass., to be laid, to lie ill: [[r:MAT.9.2|Mat 9:2]]; ἐβλήθη (timeless aor., M, Pr., 134), [[r:JHN.15.6|Jhn 15:6]]; intrans., to rush (Bl., §53, 1): [[r:ACT.27.14|Act 27:14.]] Metaphorical, β. εἰς τ. καρδίαν, [[r:JHN.13.2|Jhn 13:2]] (cf. usage in π., without idea of violence; also of liquids; MM, Exp., x; see also Cremer, 120, 657; cf. ἀμφι-, ἀνα-, ἀντι-, ἀπο-, δια-, ἐκ-, ἐμ-, παρ-εμ-, ἐπι-, κατα-, μετα-, παρα-, περι-, προ-, συμ-, ὑπερ-, ὑπο-βάλλω). (AS)

G0907.strongs: to immerse, submerge; to make whelmed (i.e. fully wet); used only (in the New Testament) of ceremonial ablution, especially (technically) of the ordinance of Christian baptism
senses: generally (in Polyb., iii, 72, of soldiers wading breast-deep; in i, 51, of the sinking of ships); metaphorically, to overwhelm (Is, l.with; cf. MM, Exp., x); with cogn. accusative, βάπτισμα β., [[r:MRK.10.38|Mrk 10:38, 39]] [[r:LUK.12.50|Luk 12:50]]. Mid.,
to perform ablutions, wash oneself, bathe (Ki, Jth, Si, ll. with): [[r:MRK.7.4|Mrk 7:4]]; aor. pass, in same sense, [[r:LUK.11.38|Luk 11:38.]]
Of ablution, immersion, as a religious rite, to baptize;

with prepositions: ἐν, of the element, [[r:MAT.3.6|Mat 3:6, 11]] [[r:MRK.1.4|Mrk 1:4, 5 8]], [[r:LUK.3.16|Luk 3:16]], [[r:JHN.1.26|Jhn 1:26, 31 33 3:23]], [[r:ACT.1.5|Act 1:5 2:38 10:48 11:16]], [[r:1CO.10.2|1Co 10:2]]; εἰς, of the element, purpose or result (Lft., Notes, 155), [[r:MAT.3.1|Mat 3:1 28:19]], [[r:MRK.1.9|Mrk 1:9]], [[r:ACT.8.16|Act 8:16 19:3, 5]] [[r:ROM.6.3|Rom 6:3]], [[r:1COR.1.13|1Co 1:13]] 15 10:2 12:13, [[r:GAL.3.27|Gal 3:27]]; with dative, ὕδατι, [[r:LUK.3.16|Luk 3:16]], [[r:ACT.1.5|Act 1:5 11:16]]; ὑπὲρ τῶν νεκρῶν, perh. to fulfil the wish of a dead friend, [[r:1CO.15.29|1Co 15:29]] (see ICC, in l.; cf. DB, i, 238ff.; DCG, i, 169a; ii, 605b; Cremer, 126). † (AS)

G0908.forms: βάπτισμα, -τος, τό (βαπτίζω), prop., the result of the act, τὸ βαπτίζειν, as distinct from βαπτισμός, the act itself
senses: of Christian baptism; [[r:ROM.6.4|Rom 6:4]], [[r:EPH.4.5|Eph 4:5]], [[r:COL.2.12|Col 2:12]] (Tr., -μῷ, which see), [[r:1PE.3.21|1Pe 3:21]] (cf. Cremer, 130; Tr., Syn. §xcix). † (AS)

G0909.forms: βαπτισμός, -οῦ, ὁ (βαπτίζω), prop., the act of which βάπτισμα is the result
senses: a dipping, washing, lustration: [[r:MRK.7.4|Mrk 7:4]]; of Jewish ceremonial. [[r:HEB.9.10|Heb 9:10]]; in [[r:HEB.6.2|Heb 6:2]], βαπτισμῶν διδαχήν (-ῆς), "the pl. and the peculiar form seem to be used to include Christian baptism with other lustral rites" (Westc, in l.).

baptism: FlJ, Ant., 18, 5, 2 (of John's baptism), and some Fathers (see Soph., see word). Not so in NT, unless ἐν τ. βαπτισμῷ, in the act of baptism, [[r:COL.2.12|Col 2:12]], be read with Tr. (Rec., WH, R, -ματι). † (AS)

G0910.strongs: a baptizer, as an epithet of Christ's forerunner
senses: βαπτιστής, -ου, ὁ (βαπτίζω), a baptizer: of John the Baptist, [[r:MAT.3.1|Mat 3:1 11:11, 12 14:2, 8 16:14 17:13]], [[r:MRK.6.25|Mrk 6:25 8:28]], [[r:LUK.7.20|Luk 7:20, 33 9:19]].† (AS)

G0911.strongs: to whelm, i.e. cover wholly with a fluid; in the New Testament only in a qualified or special sense, i.e. (literally) to moisten (a part of one's person), or (by implication) to stain (as with dye)
senses: to dip in dye, to dye: [[r:REV.19.13|Rev 19:13]] (Rec.; ῥεραντισμένον, WH; περιρεραμμένον, T; ῥεραμμένον, Swete, in l., which see). † (AS)

G0912.forms: Βαραββᾶς, -ᾶ, ὁ (Aram. בַּר־אַבָּא, lit., son of a father, i.e. accusative to Jerome, filius magistri)
G0912.strongs: son of Abba; Bar-abbas, an Israelite

G0915.forms: βάρβαρος, -ον (prob. onomatop., descriptive of unintelligible sounds)
senses: barbarous, barbarian, strange to Greek language and culture (and also, after the Persian war, with the added sense of brutal, rude): [[r:ACT.28.2|Act 28:2]], 4 [[r:ROM.1.14|Rom 1:14]], [[r:1CO.14.11|1Co 14:11]], [[r:COL.3.11|Col 3:11]] (see Lft., in l., and Notes, 249).† (AS)

G0916.forms: βαρέω, -ῶ (later form of βαρύνω, which see)
senses: to depress, weigh down. In NT, in pass. only: [[r:MAT.26.43|Mat 26:43]], [[r:LUK.9.32|Luk 9:32 21:34]], [[r:2CO.1.8|2Co 1:8 5:4]], [[r:1TI.5.16|1Ti 5:16]].† (AS)

G0918.forms: Βαρθολομαῖος, -ου, ὁ (Aram. בַּר־תָּלְמַי, son of Tolmai)
G0918.strongs: son of Tolmai; Bar-tholomæus, a Christian apostle

G0919.strongs: son of Jesus (or Joshua); Bar-jesus, an Israelite

G0920.forms: Βαριωνᾶς, Βαριωνᾶ, -ᾶ, ὁ (Aram. בַּר־יוֹנָה, son of Jonah)
G0920.strongs: son of Jonas (or Jonah); Bar-jonas, an Israelite

G0921.strongs: son of Nabas (i.e. prophecy); Barnabas, an Israelite
senses: Βαρναβᾶς, -α, ὁ (Aram. בַּר, son, as prefix to another word interpreted in [[r:ACT.4.36|Act 4:36]], τῆς παρακλήσεως, perh. נְבוּאָה, wh., however, should be rendered by προφητεία as in II [[r:EST.6.14|Est 6:14]], LXX. Deiss., BS, 309f., thinks Β. may be a variant of the name Βαρνεβοῦς, son of Nebo, found in a Syrian Inscr., altered with a view to disguising its origin; see also Milligan, NTD, iii; Dalman, Gr., 142), Barnabas: [[r:ACT.4.36|Act 4:36 9:27 11:22, 30 12:25 13-15]], [[r:1CO.9.6|1Co 9:6]], [[r:GAL.2.1|Gal 2:1, 9 13]], [[r:COL.4.10|Col 4:10]].† (AS)

G0922.root: probably from the same as [[w:G0939]] (through the notion of going down
G0922.strongs: compare); weight; in the New Testament only, figuratively, a load, abundance, authority
senses: a weight, burden, lit. and metaphorically: [[r:MAT.20.12|Mat 20:12]], [[r:ACT.15.28|Act 15:28]], [[r:2CO.4.17|2Co 4:17]], [[r:REV.2.24|Rev 2:24]]; ἀλλήλων τὰ β., one another's faults, [[r:GAL.6.2|Gal 6:2]]; ἐν β., burdensome: [[r:1TH.2.6|1Th 2:6]], R, txt., but see infr.;
in late Gk. (Soph., Lex., see word), dignity, authority: ἐν βάρει, [[r:1TH.2.6|1Th 2:6]] (R, mg.; see Milligan, ICG, in l.).† SYN.: ὄγκος, an encumbrance; φορτίον, a burden, that which is borne. (AS)

G0923.strongs: son of Sabas (or Tsaba); Bar-sabas, the name of two Israelites

G0924.strongs: son of Timæus (or the unclean); Bar-timæus, an Israelite
senses: Βαρτίμαιος, -ου, ὁ (-μαῖος, T; perh. Aram. בַּר־טִמְאַי, see DB, iv, p. 762), Bartimæus: [[r:MRK.10.46|Mrk 10:46.]]† (AS)

heavy: [[r:MAT.23.4|Mat 23:4.]] Metaphorical, burdensome: ἐντολή, [[r:1JN.5.3|1Jn 5:3]]; severe (perh. impressive): ἐπιστολή, [[r:2CO.10.10|2Co 10:10]]; weighty: τὰ βαρύτερα τ. νόμου, [[r:MAT.23.23|Mat 23:23]]; αἰτιώματα, [[r:ACT.25.7|Act 25:7]]; violent, cruel (EV, grievous): λύκος, [[r:ACT.20.29|Act 20:29.]]† (AS)
(βαρύς, τιμή), of great value, very costly: [[r:MAT.26.7|Mat 26:7]] (T, πολυτίμου).† (AS)
prop., to rub on the touchstone, put to the test.

to examine by torture, hence, generally, to torture, torment, distress: [[r:MAT.8.6|Mat 8:6, 29 14:24]], [[r:MRK.5.7|Mrk 5:7 6:48]], [[r:LUK.8.28|Luk 8:28]], [[r:2PE.2.8|2Pe 2:8]], [[r:REV.9.5|Rev 9:5 11:10 12:2 14:10 20:10]]. † (AS)
prop., a torturer; used of a gaoler, [[r:MAT.18.34|Mat 18:34.]]† (AS)

G0931.root: perhaps remotely from the same as [[w:G0939]] (through the notion of going to the bottom)
senses: prop., touchstone, a dark stone used in testing metals.

G0932.strongs: properly, royalty, i.e. (abstractly) rule, or (concretely) a realm (literally or figuratively)
senses: prop. abstract, sovereignty, royal power, dominion: [[r:LUK.1.33|Luk 1:33 22:29]], [[r:JHN.18.36|Jhn 18:36]], [[r:ACT.1.6|Act 1:6]], [[r:HEB.1.8|Heb 1:8]], [[r:1CO.15.24|1Co 15:24]]; λαβεῖν β., [[r:LUK.19.12|Luk 19:12, 15]] [[r:REV.17.12|Rev 17:12]]; δοῦναι τὴν, ib. 17; ἔχειν β., ib. 18; ἔρχεσθαι ἐν τ. (εἰς τὴν) β., [[r:MAT.16.28|Mat 16:28]], [[r:LUK.23.42|Luk 23:42]]; β. τ. θεοῦ, [[r:REV.12.10|Rev 12:10.]]

a kingdom, the territory or people over whom the king rules ([[r:EST.5.3|Est 5:3]], al.): [[r:MAT.4.8|Mat 4:8 12:25, 26 24:7]], [[r:MRK.3.24|Mrk 3:24 6:23]], [[r:LUK.4.5|Luk 4:5]], [[r:HEB.11.33|Heb 11:33]], al.;
the royal majesty (cf. our phrase His Majesty), the king himself (τ. σπέρμα τῆς β., [[r:2KI.11.1|4Ki.11:1]]).

In LXX ([[r:WIS.6.5|Wis 6:5]], [[r:TOB.13.1|Tob 13:1]], al.), Targ. and NT, of the Messianic rule and kingdom, ἡ β. τ. θεοῦ, τ. οὐρανῶν (Heb. מַלְכוּת שָׁמַיִם, Aram. מַלְכוּתָא דִשׁמַיָּא; see Dalman, Words, 91-147; Cremer, 132, 658), the kingdom of God (on the equivalence of the two phrases, see Dalman, op. cit., 93, 218f.); τ. θεοῦ, [[r:MAT.6.33|Mat 6:33 12:28]], al.; τ. οὐρανῶν, [[r:MAT.3.2|Mat 3:2 4:17]], al.; τ. Χριστοῦ (מַלִכוּת דִמְשִׁיחא, Targ. Jon. on [[r:ISA.53.10|Isa 53:10]]), [[r:EPH.5.5|Eph 5:5]]; τ. κυρίου, [[r:2PE.1.11|2Pe 1:11]], [[r:REV.11.15|Rev 11:15]]; τ. Δαυείδ, [[r:MRK.11.10|Mrk 11:10]]; absol., ἡ β., [[r:MAT.4.23|Mat 4:23]], [[r:JAS.2.5|Jas 2:5]], al. The kingdom is regarded as present: [[r:MAT.11.12|Mat 11:12]], [[r:LUK.17.21|Luk 17:21]], [[r:ROM.14.17|Rom 14:17]], al.; as that which is to be consummated in the future, [[r:MAT.6.10|Mat 6:10]], [[r:MRK.9.1|Mrk 9:1]], [[r:JHN.3.5|Jhn 3:5]], [[r:2PE.1.11|2Pe 1:11]], al. Noteworthy phrases are: ζητεῖν τὴν β., [[r:MAT.6.33|Mat 6:33]]; δέχεσθαι, [[r:MRK.10.15|Mrk 10:15]]; κλρονομεῖν, [[r:MAT.25.34|Mat 25:34]]; διδόναι, [[r:LUK.12.32|Lk 12:32]]; παραλαμβάνειν, [[r:HEB.12.28|Heb 12:28]]; αὐτῶν (τοιούτων) εστὶν ἡ β., [[r:MAT.5.3|Mat 5:3, 10 19:14]], [[r:MRK.10.14|Mrk 10:14]], [[r:LUK.18.16|Luk 18:16]]; διὰ τὴν β., [[r:MAT.19.12|Mat 19:12]]; ἕνεκεν τῆς β., [[r:LUK.18.29|Luk 18:29]]; εὐαγγελίζεσθαι, κηρύσσειν, διαγγέλλειν τὴν β., [[r:LUK.4.43|Luk 4:43 9:2, 60]]; ἤγγικεν ἡ β., [[r:MAT.3.2|Mat 3:2]], [[r:MRK.1.15|Mrk 1:15]]; κλεῖς τῆς β., [[r:MAT.16.10|Mat 16:10]]; κλείειν τὴν β., [[r:MAT.23.14|Mat 23:14]]; υἱοὶ τῆς β., [[r:MAT.8.12|Mat 8:12 13:38]] (cf. Cremer, 132, 658). (AS)
royal: [[r:1PE.2.9|1Pe 2:9]] (LXX) (see Hort, in l.).† royal, regal, kingly;, metaphorically possessed of high prerogatives and distinction, [[r:1PE.2.9|1Pet 2:9]]; (AS)

G0935.root: probably from [[w:G0939]] (through the notion of a foundation of power)
senses: a king: [[r:MAT.1.6|Mat 1:6 2:1]]; used by courtesy of Herod the Tetrarch, [[r:MAT.14.9|Mat 14:9]]; of the Roman Emperor, as frequently in κοινή (Deiss., LAE, p. 367), [[r:1PE.2.13|1Pe 2:13, 17]]; of the Christ, in the phrase ὁ β. τ. Ἰουδαίων, [[r:MAT.2.2|Mat 2:2]], al.; τοῦ Ἰσραήλ, [[r:MRK.15.32|Mrk 15:32]], [[r:JHN.1.50|Jhn 1:50 12:13]]; of God, [[r:MAT.5.35|Mat 5:35]], [[r:1TI.1.17|1Ti 1:17]], [[r:REV.15.3|Rev 15:3]]; β. βασιλέων, [[r:REV.17.14|Rev 17:14 19:16]]; β. τ. βασιλευόντων, [[r:1TI.6.15|1Ti 6:15]] (on the associations of the word to Jewish Hellenists, see Cl. Rev., i, 7).† (AS)

to be king, to reign, rule: [[r:1TI.6.15|1Ti 6:15]]; with genitive (cl.), [[r:MAT.2.22|Mat 2:22]]; before ἐπί, with accusative (= Heb. מלךְ על; Bl., §36, 8), [[r:LUK.1.33|Luk 1:33 19:14, 27]] [[r:ROM.5.14|Rom 5:14]]; ἐπὶ τ. γῆς, on earth, [[r:REV.5.10|Rev 5:10]]; of God, [[r:REV.11.15|Rev 11:15, 17 19:6]]; of Christ, [[r:LUK.1.33|Luk 1:33]], [[r:1CO.15.25|1Co 15:25]], [[r:REV.11.15|Rev 11:15]]; of Christians, [[r:REV.5.10|Rev 5:10 20:4]] (constative aor., M, Pr., 130), ib. 6 22:5. Metaphorical, Christians, [[r:ROM.5.17|Rom 5:17]], [[r:1CO.4.8|1Co 4:8]]; θάνατος, [[r:ROM.5.14|Rom 5:14, 17]]; ἁμαρτία, [[r:ROM.5.21|Rom 5:21 6:12]]. Ingressive aor. (M, Pr., 109), to begin to reign: [[r:1CO.4.8|1Co 4:8]], [[r:REV.11.17|Rev 11:17 19:6]] (Cremer, 137).† (AS)

G0937.strongs: regal (in relation), i.e. (literally) belonging to (or befitting) the sovereign (as land, dress, or a courtier), or (figuratively) preeminent
senses: royal, belonging to a king: χώρα, [[r:ACT.12.20|Act 12:20]]; ἐσθής, [[r:ACT.12.21|Act 12:21]]; νόμος β., a supreme law, "a law which governs other laws and so has a specially regal character" (Hort), or because made by a king (LAE, p. 3673), [[r:JAS.2.8|Jas 2:8]]; τις, one in the service of a king, a courtier, [[r:JHN.4.46|Jhn 4:46, 49]] (WH, mg., βασιλίσκος).† (AS)

G0939.strongs: a pace ("base"), i.e. (by implication) the foot

G0940.strongs: to malign, i.e. (by extension) to fascinate (by false representations)
senses: to blight by the evil eye, to fascinate, bewitch: [[r:GAL.3.1|Gal 3:1.]] † (AS)

G0941.root: perhaps remotely derived from the base of [[w:G0939]] (through the idea of removal)
G0941.strongs: to lift, literally or figuratively (endure, declare, sustain, receive, etc.)
senses: to take up with the hands, to lift: λίθους, [[r:JHN.10.31|Jhn 10:31.]]
In late writers (MM, Exp., ii, iii, x),
a bramble-bush: [[r:LUK.6.44|Luk 6:44]], [[r:ACT.7.30|Act 7:30, 35]]; ἐπὶ τοῦ (τῆς) β., in the place concerning the bush: [[r:MRK.12.26|Mrk 12:26]], [[r:LUK.20.37|Luk 20:37]].† (AS)

G0943.strongs: a bath, or measure for liquids
senses: bath, a Jewish liquid measure, = μετρητής (which see), or about 8 3/4 gals.: [[r:LUK.16.6|Luk 16:6.]]† (AS)

G0945.strongs: to stutter, i.e. (by implication) to prate tediously
senses: βατταλογέω, -ῶ (Rec. βαττολ-, D, βλαττ- = βατταρίζω, prob. onomatop.; see MM, see word; DCG, ii, 499b, 790a); to stammer, repeat idly: [[r:MAT.6.7|Mat 6:7]] (Cremer, 765).† (AS)

(βδελύσσω), an abomination, a detestable thing: [[r:LUK.16.15|Luk 16:15]], [[r:REV.17.4|Rev 17:4, 5 21:27]]; τὸ β. τ. ἐρημώσεως (Dan LXX 12:11, cf. [[r:1MA.1.54|1Ma 1:54]]; DB, i, 12f.; DCG, i, 6f.), [[r:MRK.13.14|Mrk 13:14]], [[r:MAT.24.15|Mat 24:15]] (Cremer, 138).† (AS)

G0948.root: from a (presumed) derivative of βδέω (to stink)
G0948.strongs: to be disgusted, i.e. (by implication) detest (especially of idolatry)
senses: (βδέω, to stink), in cl., mid. only (Attic, -ττομαι); to make foul; pass., [[r:REV.21.8|Rev 21:8]]; mid., to turn away in disgust from, to detest: [[r:ROM.2.22|Rom 2:22]] (Cremer, 137).† (AS)

G0949.root: from the base of [[w:G0939]] (through the idea of basality)
senses: firm, secure: ἄγκυρα, [[r:HEB.6.19|Heb 6:19]]; metaphorically, sure (esp. "in the sense of legally guaranteed security," Deiss., BS, 109; cf. two foll. words): ἐπαγγελία, [[r:ROM.4.16|Rom 4:16]]; ἐλπίς, [[r:2CO.1.6|2Co 1:6]]; λόγος, [[r:HEB.2.2|Heb 2:2]]; παρρησία, [[r:HEB.3.6|Heb 3:6]]; ἀρχή (τ. ὑποστάσεως), [[r:HEB.3.14|Heb 3:14]]; διαθήκη, [[r:HEB.9.17|Heb 9:17]]; κλῆσις κ. ἐκλογή, [[r:2PE.1.10|2Pe 1:10]]; comp. (-ότερος), προφητικὸς λόγος, [[r:2PE.1.19|2Pe 1:19.]]† (AS)

(βέβαιος), to confirm, establish, secure, of things (cl.): λόγον, Mk 16:; ἐπαγγελίας, [[r:ROM.15.8|Rom 15:8]]; of persons (DCG, ii, 605): [[r:1CO.1.8|1Co 1:8]], [[r:2CO.1.21|2Co 1:21]]. Pass., [[r:1CO.1.6|1Co 1:6]], [[r:COL.2.7|Col 2:7]], [[r:HEB.2.3|Heb 2:3 13:9]] (as an Attic legal term, to guarantee the validity of a purchase, establish or confirm a title; see next word, Cremer, 139; cf. δια-β.).† (AS)

(βεβαιόω, which see), confirmation: τ. εὐαγγελίου, [[r:PHP.1.7|Php 1:7]]; εἰς β., [[r:HEB.6.16|Heb 6:16]], a phrase frequently in π. of guarantee in a business transaction (Deiss., BS, 104ff.; Cremer, 140).† (AS)

G0952.root: from the base of [[w:G0939]] and βηλός (a threshold)
G0952.strongs: accessible (as by crossing the door-way), i.e. (by implication, of Jewish notions) heathenish, wicked
senses: permitted to be trodden, accessible (see DCG, ii, 422b); hence,
(opposite to ἱερός) unhallowed, profane: of things, [[r:1TI.4.7|1Ti 4:7 6:20]], [[r:2TI.2.16|2Ti 2:16]]; of men, [[r:1TI.1.9|1Ti 1:9]], [[r:HEB.12.16|Heb 12:16]] (cf. κοινός; Cremer, 140). † (AS)
(βέβηλος), to profane: τ. σάββατον, [[r:MAT.12.5|Mat 12:5]]; τ. ἱερόν, [[r:ACT.24.6|Act 24:6]] (Cremer, 141).† SYN.: κοινόω, which see (AS)

G0954.forms: Βεελζεβούλ (WH, App., 159, Rec., βεελζεβούλ), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. בַּעַל, lord, and the Talmudic זִבּוּל, from זֶבֶל, dung (Dalman, Gr., 137.n), or perh. זִבֻל, habitation, but, see DB, iv, 409f.; DCG, i, 181). The AV, RV, Beelzebub, comes through Vg. from [[r:2KI.1.2|4Ki.1:2]], בַּעַל זִבוּב, lord of flies (LXX, βάαλ μυῖα, Sm., βεελζεβούβ)
G0954.strongs: dung-god; Beelzebul, a name of Satan

G0955.forms: Βελίαλ, ὁ, indecl. (Heb. בְּלִיַּעַל, worthlessness, but see DB, i, 268)
G0955.strongs: worthlessness; Belial, as an epithet of Satan
senses: Belial, a name of Satan: [[r:2CO.6.15|2Co 6:15]], Rec. See next word.† Βελιάρ, ὁ, indecl. (another form of previous word, "due to harsh Syriac pronunciation," or else Heb. בֵּל יַעַר, lord of the forest), Beliar, a name of Satan: [[r:2CO.6.15|2Co 6:15]] (see DB, i, 269).† (AS)

G0956.strongs: a missile, i.e. spear or arrow

G0957.root: neuter of a compound of a derivative of [[w:G0906]] (used for the comparative of [[w:G0018]])
senses: neut. as adv., better, very well: [[r:2TI.1.18|2Ti 1:18]] (also [[r:ACT.10.28|Act 10:28]] D). On elative use in these passages, see M, Pr., 78, 236.† (AS)

G0959.forms: Βερνίκη (elsewhere Βερενίκη), Macedonian form of Φερενίκη, cf. Veronica, Victoria), -ης, ἡ
G0959.root: from a provincial form of [[w:G5342]] and [[w:G3529]]
G0959.strongs: victorious; Bernice, a member of the Herodian family
senses: Bernice, Berenice, dau. of Herod Agrippa I: [[r:ACT.25.13|Act 25:13, 23 26:3]]o.† (AS)

G0960.root: perhaps a provincial from a derivative of [[w:G4008]] (Perœa, i.e. the region beyond the coast-line)

G0961.strongs: a Berœoean or native of Berœa

G0963.forms: Βηθανία, -ας (also -ιά, indecl., [[r:LUK.19.29|Luk 19:29]] and in B*, [[r:MRK.11.1|Mrk 11:1]]), ἡ, (Heb. בֵּית עֲנִיָּה, house of affliction, accusative to Jerome, or perh., house of dates, cf. Bethphage)
G0963.strongs: date-house; Beth-any, a place in Palestine
senses: a village fifteen furlongs from Jerusalem, the modern El Azerîyeh: [[r:MAT.21.17|Mat 21:17 26:6]], [[r:MRK.8.22|Mrk 8:22]] (WH, mg.) 11:1, 11, 12 14:3 [[r:LUK.19.29|Luk 19:29 24:50]], [[r:JHN.11.1|Jhn 11:1, 18 12:1]].
A place on E. bank of Jordan: [[r:JHN.1.28|Jhn 1:28]] (R, mg., Βηθαβαρά, which see). † (AS)

G0964.strongs: house of kindness; Beth-esda, a pool in Jerusalem
senses: Βηθεσδά, ἡ, indecl. (deriv. uncertain, see Westc. on [[r:JHN.5.2|Jhn 5:2]], and DB, i, 279), Bethesda, a pool in Jerusalem: [[r:JHN.5.2|Jhn 5:2]], Rec. (Βηθζαθά, WH, Βηθσαϊδά, WH, mg.).† (AS)

G0965.strongs: Bethleem (i.e. Beth-lechem), a place in Palestine
senses: Βηθλέεμ, ἡ, indecl. (Heb. בֵּית לֶחֶם, house of bread), Bethlehem, a town 6 m. S. of Jerusalem: [[r:MAT.2.1|Mat 2:1, 5 6, 8, 16]], [[r:LUK.2.4|Luk 2:4, 15]] [[r:JHN.7.42|Jhn 7:42]].† (AS)

G0966.strongs: fishing-house; Bethsaida, a place in Palestine
senses: Βηθσαιδά (Rec. -σαϊδά), and -δάν (Mt, Mk, ll. with), ἡ, indecl. (Syr., house of fish), Bethsaida, a town on NE. shore of the Sea of Galilee: [[r:LUK.9.10|Luk 9:10.]] It is generally supposed that a second B. on the W. shore is referred to in [[r:MAT.11.21|Mat 11:21]], [[r:MRK.6.45|Mrk 6:45 8:22]], [[r:LUK.10.13|Luk 10:13]], [[r:JHN.1.45|Jhn 1:45 12:21]] (DB, i, 282f.; but see Swete on [[r:MRK.6.45|Mrk 6:45]]).
2. Βηθζαθά, ἡ, indecl. (perh. Aram. בֵּית זַיְתָה, house of olives) [[r:JHN.5.2|Jhn 5:2.]].† (AS)

G0967.forms: Βηθφαγή (L, -γῆ), ἡ, indecl. (Aram. בֵּית־פַּגֵּי, house of unripe figs; Dalman, Gr., 191)
G0967.strongs: fig-house; Beth-phage, a place in Palestine

G0968.strongs: a step, i.e. foot-breath; by implication, a rostrum, i.e. a tribunal
senses: a raised place, a platform reached by steps, originally that in the Pnyx at Athens from which orations were made; frequently of the tribune or tribunal of a Roman magistrate or ruler: [[r:MAT.27.19|Mat 27:19]], [[r:JHN.19.13|Jhn 19:13]], [[r:ACT.12.21|Act 12:21, 18:12, 16, 17 25:6, 10, 17]]; β. τοῦ θεοῦ, [[r:ROM.14.10|Rom 14:10]]; τ. Χριστοῦ, [[r:2CO.5.10|2Co 5:10.]] † (AS)

G0970.root: probably akin to [[w:G0979]] (through the idea of vital activity)

G0971.strongs: to force, i.e. (reflexively) to crowd oneself (into), or (passively) to be seized
senses: to force, constrain, rare in active (poet, and late prose), but found in cl. in pass., and so perh. βιάζεται, suffereth violence, [[r:MAT.11.12|Mat 11:12]], EV (but see infr.), whether
in good sense, of disciples (Thayer, al.), or

in bad sense, of the enemies of the kingdom (Meyer, in l.; Dalman, Words, 139ff.; Cremer, 141ff.). Mid., advanceth violently, Mt, l.with (Deiss., BS., 258; Banks, see ref. in DCG, ii, 803f.); before εἰς, to press violently, or force one's way into, [[r:LUK.16.16|Luk 16:16]] (see ICC, in l., and in Mt, l.with; cf. παραβιάζομαι and see MM, see word). † (AS)

G0973.forms: βιαστής, -οῦ, ὁ (βιάζω), late form of βιατάς;

G0974.forms: βιβλαρίδιον, -ου, τό (diminutive of βιβλάριον, diminutive of βίβλος)
senses: a little book: [[r:REV.10.2|Rev 10:2]], 8 (WH, βιβλιόν, T2, 7 βιβλιδάριον) 9, 10. Not hitherto found elsewhere.† (AS)

G0975.forms: βιβλίον, -ου, τό (diminutive of βίβλος, which see)
senses: a paper, letter, written document: β. ἀποστασίου, bill of divorce, [[r:MAT.19.7|Mat 19:7]], [[r:MRK.10.4|Mrk 10:4]].

G0976.forms: βίβλος, -ου, ἡ (variant form of βύβλος, the Egyptian papyrus, paper made from its fibrous coat)
G0976.root: properly, the inner bark of the papyrus plant, i.e. (by implication) a sheet or scroll of writing
senses: a book, a roll, used much less frequently than βιβλίον, and with a "connotation of sacredness and veneration" (MM, Exp., x), [[r:MAT.1.1|Mat 1:1]] [[r:MRK.12.26|Mrk 12:26]], [[r:LUK.3.4|Luk 3:4 20:42]] [[r:ACT.1.20|Act 1:20 7:42 19:19]]; β. τ. ζωῆς, [[r:PHP.4.3|Php 4:3]], [[r:REV.3.5|Rev 3:5 20:15]].† (AS)

G0977.root: a reduplicated and prolonged form of an obsolete primary verb (perhaps causative of [[w:G1006]])

G0979.strongs: life, i.e. (literally) the present state of existence; by implication, the means of livelihood
senses: living, livelihood, means (in [[r:PRO.31.14|Pro 31:14]] for לֶחֶם; see DCG, ii, 39a): [[r:MRK.12.44|Mrk 12:44]], [[r:LUK.8.43|Luk 8:43 15:12, 30 21:4]], [[r:1JN.3.17|1Jn 3:17]].† SYN.: ζωή, is life intensive, "vita quâ, vivimus," the vital principle; βίος, life extensive, "vita quam vivimus," (1) the period of life, (2) the means by which it is sustained. Hence, in cl., ζ., being confined to the physical life common to men and animals, is the inferior word (cf. zoology, biography). In NT, ζωή is elevated into the ethical and spiritual sphere (cf. Tr., Syn., §xxvii). (AS)
(βίος), to spend life, to live: τ. χρόνον βιῶσαι (cl., more frequently 2 aor., -ναι), [[r:1PE.4.2|1Pe 4:2]] (cf. Jb, l.with).† SYN.: ζάω (which see). (AS)

G0981.strongs: living (properly, the act, by implication, the mode)

G0982.kjv: of (pertaining to, things that pertain to) this life

G0984.strongs: properly, to hinder, i.e. (by implication) to injure

G0985.strongs: to germinate; by implication, to yield fruit
senses: In late Gk., causal, to make to grow, produce: with accusative, [[r:JAS.5.18|Jas 5:18.]] † (AS)

G0986.root: perhaps the same as the base of [[w:G0985]]
G0986.strongs: Blastus, an officer of Herod Agrippa

G0987.strongs: to vilify; specially, to speak impiously
G0987.kjv: (speak) blaspheme(-er, -mously, -my), defame, rail on, revile, speak evil
senses: to speak lightly or profanely of sacred things (in cl., opp. of εὐφημέω), esp. to speak impiously of God, to blaspheme, speak blasphemously: absol., [[r:MAT.9.3|Mat 9:3 26:65]], [[r:MRK.2.7|Mrk 2:7]], [[r:JHN.10.36|Jhn 10:36]], [[r:ACT.26.11|Act 26:11]], [[r:1TI.1.20|1Ti 1:20]], [[r:2PE.2.12|2Pe 2:12]]; τ. θεόν, [[r:ACT.19.37|Act 19:37]], [[r:REV.16.11|Rev 16:11, 21]]; τὸ ὄνομα τ. θεοῦ, [[r:REV.13.6|Rev 13:6 16:9]]; δόξας, Ju 3, [[r:2PE.2.10|2Pe 2:10]]; εἰς τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον, [[r:MRK.3.29|Mrk 3:29]], [[r:LUK.12.10|Luk 12:10]].

spec., impious speech against God, blasphemy: [[r:MAT.26.65|Mat 26:65]], [[r:MRK.14.64|Mrk 14:64]], [[r:LUK.5.21|Luk 5:21]], [[r:JHN.10.33|Jhn 10:33]], [[r:REV.13.5|Rev 13:5]]; ὄνομα βλασφημίας, [[r:REV.13.1|Rev 13:1 17:3]]; with genitive obj. [[r:MAT.12.31|Mat 12:31]]; πρὸς τ. θεόν, [[r:REV.13.6|Rev 13:6]] (Cremer, 570; DB, i, 305; DCG ii, 423).† (AS)

G0989.strongs: scurrilious, i.e. calumnious (against men), or (specially) impious (against God)
senses: (βλασ-, of uncertain deriv., see Thayer, Boisacq; + φήμη, speech),
(βλέπω), a look, a glance: βλέμματι καὶ ἀκοῇ, [[r:2PE.2.8|2Pe 2:8]], sight and hearing, a sense not found for β. in Gk. lit., but perh. recognized in the vernacular (ICC, in l.)† (AS)

G0991.kjv: behold, beware, lie, look (on, to), perceive, regard, see, sight, take heed
senses: to see, have sight (opposite to τυφλὸς): [[r:MAT.12.22|Mat 12:22]], [[r:JHN.9.7|Jhn 9:7]], [[r:ACT.9.9|Act 9:9]], [[r:ROM.11.8|Rom 11:8]], [[r:REV.3.18|Rev 3:18]], al.;

to perceive, look (at), see: absol., [[r:ACT.1.9|Act 1:9]]; with accusative, [[r:MAT.7.3|Mat 7:3]], [[r:MRK.5.31|Mrk 5:31]], [[r:LUK.6.41|Luk 6:41]], [[r:JHN.1.29|Jhn 1:29]], al.; ὅραμα, [[r:ACT.12.9|Act 12:9]]; γυναῖκα, [[r:MAT.5.28|Mat 5:28]]; βιβλίον, [[r:REV.5.3|Rev 5:3]], 4; τ. βλεπόμενα, [[r:2CO.4.18|2Co 4:18.]]

to see, perceive, discern: absol., [[r:MAT.13.13|Mat 13:13]], [[r:LUK.8.10|Luk 8:10]]; δι ̓ ἐσόπτρου, [[r:1CO.13.12|1Co 13:12]]; with accusative, [[r:HEB.2.9|Heb 2:9 10:25]]; before ὅτι, [[r:HEB.3.19|Heb 3:19]], [[r:JAS.2.22|Jas 2:22]];

to consider, look to, take heed: absol., [[r:MRK.13.23|Mrk 13:23, 33]]; with accusative, [[r:1CO.1.26|1Co 1:26]], al.; before πῶς, with indic., [[r:LUK.8.18|Luk 8:18]], [[r:1CO.3.10|1Co 3:10]], [[r:EPH.5.15|Eph 5:15]]; before τί, with indic., [[r:MRK.4.24|Mrk 4:24]]; before εἰς πρόσωπον, of partiality, [[r:MAT.22.16|Mat 22:16]], [[r:MRK.12.14|Mrk 12:14]]. Colloq. (for ex. from π., V. Deiss., LAE, 122; M, Pr., 107; MM, Exp., x; Milligan, NTD, 50), β. ἑαυτόν: [[r:MRK.13.9|Mrk 13:9]]; before ἵνα μή, II Jo 8; β. ἀπό, [[r:MRK.8.15|Mrk 8:15 12:38]]; before μή (cl. ὁρᾶν), with fut. indic., [[r:COL.2.8|Col 2:8]], [[r:HEB.3.12|Heb 3:12]]; id. with aor. subj., [[r:MAT.24.4|Mat 24:4]], [[r:MRK.13.5|Mrk 13:5]].

Of situation and direction (Lat. specto), to look, face (towards), places, etc. (before πρός, Xen, Hell., vii, 1, 17; [[r:EZK.40.23|Eze 40:23, 24]]): before κατά, with accusative, [[r:ACT.27.12|Act 27:12]] (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο-, δια-, ἐμ-, ἐπι-, περ-, προ-βλέπω), see DCG, i, 446; ii, 596. (AS)

G0993.strongs: sons of commotion; Boanerges, an epithet of two of the apostles
senses: Βοανηργές, indecl. (on the derivation, see Dalman, Gr., 144; Words, 42; Swete, Mk., l.with; DCG, i, 216), Boanerges: [[r:MRK.3.17|Mrk 3:17.]]† (AS)

G0994.root: apparently a prolonged form of a primary verb
G0994.strongs: to halloo, i.e. shout (for help or in a tumultuous way)
senses: C. dative, to call on for help (Heb. זעק על, [[r:HOS.7.14|Hos 7:14]], al.), [[r:LUK.18.7|Luk 18:7]].† SYN.: καλέω, to call, invite, summon; κράζω, to cry, harshly or inarticulately, as animals; κραυγάζω, intensive of κράζω. βοάω expresses emotion, whether joy, fear, etc. (AS)

G0995.strongs: a halloo, i.e. call (for aid, etc.)

G0996.strongs: aid; specially, a rope or chain for frapping a vessel
senses: help: [[r:HEB.4.16|Heb 4:16]]; pl., helps, "frapping," a technical nautical term (MM, Exp., x; DB, ext., 367): [[r:ACT.27.17|Act 27:17.]]† (AS)

(βοή + θέω, to run), to come to aid, to help, succour: absol., [[r:ACT.21.28|Act 21:28]]; with dative, [[r:MAT.15.25|Mat 15:25]], [[r:MRK.9.22|Mrk 9:22, 24]] [[r:ACT.16.9|Act 16:9]], [[r:2CO.6.2|2Co 6:2]]" (LXX), [[r:HEB.2.18|Heb 2:18]], [[r:REV.12.16|Rev 12:16]].† (AS)

G0999.forms: βόθυνος, -ου, ὁ (= βόθρος, more frequently in cl.)
G0999.strongs: a hole (in the ground); specially, a cistern

senses: Freq. in pl., τὰ β., a palace: [[r:LUK.7.25|Luk 7:25.]] † (AS)

G0962.strongs: ferry-house; Bethabara (i.e. Bethabarah), a place on the Jordan
senses: Βηθαβαρά, -ας (Rec. -ρᾶ, indecl.; Heb. בֵּית עֲבָרָה, place of crossing; -αραβᾷ, R, mg.), Bethabara: [[r:JHN.1.28|Jhn 1:28]], Rec. (WH, R, βηθανία).† (AS)
